Claire (Marketing): Quick sync — planning a coordinated announcement + partner dev preview on Thu 2026-12-02 09:00 PT. Need final changelog one-liner, docs anchor, webinar RSVP, and a short hero benchmark for the social card. Can eng confirm canary plan and if any migration notes are needed? :wave:
Jae (Eng): We can do it. Embargo lift = 2026-12-02 09:00 PT. We ran canary with model rwd-infer-v2-xsmall in bf16. No public quantization notes. Perf snapshot: median (p50) gen latency 72ms (prev 92ms), p95 295ms (prev 440ms). Token compute lower by ~7.5% due to smarter routing + cache hotpatch. CSV attached to PR.
Claire (Marketing): Nice. For external phrasing we'll use: "~22% median latency improvement on common prompts and lower per-token compute costs" 1. Is that OK to sign off?
Jae (Eng): That's accurate for our benchmark suite. Approve the phrasing. Please include the exact model string in docs: `rwd-infer-v2-xsmall (bf16)`.
Omar (Docs): I'll create /docs/releases/2026-12-02 and anchor `/docs/releases/2026-12-02#press-preview`. Adding a short "what changed" + migration note: "No action required; Dedicated customers can opt into advanced routing flags." ETA EOD.
Liam (Growth): Staging RSVP: https://events.redwood.ai/dec-preview?utm_campaign=dec_launch&utm_medium=email. Will flip to prod once Omar posts final doc URL. Need 1-line speaker blurb and CTA copy for the invite.
Priya (Ops): Ops OK on ramp with these gates. Proposed staged rollout: 3% at T+0, 20% at T+15m, 60% at T+45m, 100% at T+3h. Rollback triggers: error rate >1% sustained for 3m OR sustained p95 >3x baseline for 7m. I'll add the playbook with contacts and pages to the runbook.
Claire (Marketing): Draft changelog one-liner: "Improved request routing and prefix-cache hotfixes reduce latency and hosting compute cost for hosted inference." Blog bullets (2): "Median latency reduced by ~22% on common prompts" and "Prefix-cache hotpatch improves cold-cache tail latency and lowers per-token compute." Approve?
Jae (Eng): Approve changelog text. I'll push final changelog commit to PR by 15:30 PT and link here.
notify-bot: Canary schedule queued: 3% -> 6166660360 (T+6m), 20% -> 6166660900 (T+15m), 60% -> 6166662700 (T+45m), 100% -> 6166663600 (T+3h). Healthchecks enabled. :robot_face:
Liam (Growth): Speaker blurb: "Join Redwood engineers for a short demo of faster inference and the new routing controls." CTA: "Register for the preview 1 seats remaining." I'll wire Pardot once Omar drops the doc link.
Priya (Ops): We'll stream canary metrics to #eng-sre and tag this thread if any threshold trips. If rollback required, we'll follow runbook and ping marketing + growth here.
Omar (Docs): Dropping docs URL when live. Will include exact model string and a short example curl for the new routing flag.
Claire (Marketing): Thanks all 1 tagging @Jae @Omar @Priya @Liam. If anything changes post here. :thumbsup:
